name: revelado
description: Drive the local Revelado RAW developer: technical culling, diagnostics, sample-first developing and safe exports.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to the Revelado engine running on this computer. Only the folders you choose below can be opened, exports go only to the export folders you choose, originals are never modified, and previews sent to Claude are at most 1024 px without metadata. The Revelado app/engine must be running.

allowed_dirs.title: Photo folders
allowed_dirs.description: Folders whose photos Claude may open (read-only).

export_dirs.title: Export folders
export_dirs.description: Folders where finished files may be written. Leave empty to disable export.

engine_url.title: Engine URL
engine_url.description: Local Revelado engine address (must be on this computer).

token_file.title: Engine token file (optional)
token_file.description: The '.runtime_token' file the engine writes on start, if it is not in the default location.

tools.name: engine_status
tools.description: Engine health, capabilities and allowed folders

tools.name: list_sessions
tools.description: Previously opened folders inside the allow-list

tools.name: list_photos
tools.description: List photos with filters (rating, flag, cull verdict, camera)

tools.name: get_photo_info
tools.description: EXIF summary, camera/lens profile and cull result

tools.name: get_preview
tools.description: Small preview image (<=1024 px, no metadata)

tools.name: diagnose
tools.description: Noise / chromatic aberration / shading statistics and masks

tools.name: auto_cull_technical
tools.description: Local technical cull (sharpness, eyes, exposure, bursts)

tools.name: list_films
tools.description: Film looks and whether they are trained

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Working develop recipe and its schema

tools.name: develop_sample
tools.description: Develop one photo and return before/after previews

tools.name: job_status
tools.description: Progress and outputs of an engine job

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a job started from this server

tools.name: export
tools.description: Write finished files to an allowed export folder (requires confirm=true)
